Packaging_Configuration: 100 mL PP refill pod/cup + retained outer jar
Primary_Materials: Thin-wall PP pod, lid/seal; outer jar reused
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Estimated 30–60% lower packaging mass per refill than a new jar, excluding amortized outer jar
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary refill-unit estimate; tooling may be substantial
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: PP resin ~€1.56–1.61/kg raw proxy
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Cream viscosity, transfer hygiene, oxygen exposure and repeat-refill contamination need validation.
Required_Catalogue_Data: Pod dimensions/fit, seal material, reuse cycles, consumer instructions, hygiene/stability and outer-jar amortization.
Important_Notes: Benefit depends on actual reuse of outer jar.

Packaging_Configuration: Solid balm in aluminium tin with paperboard sleeve
Primary_Materials: Aluminium tin/lid with possible lacquer; paperboard sleeve
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Estimated lower package mass per purchased unit in some designs; fill/use not equivalent
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary planning band; exact tin/sleeve quote required
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: Aluminium €2.70–4.50/kg; paperboard €1.20–1.80/kg are raw stock planning estimates
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Not a drop-in for lotion. Format/formula change; test oil/fragrance contact, coating/corrosion, heat stability and use equivalence.
Required_Catalogue_Data: Tin body/lid mass, lacquer, product contact, paper gsm/coating, stability and use-dose comparison.
Important_Notes: Compare per application/use; validate solid formula separately.

Packaging_Configuration: 100 mL PCR-PP jar + PP lid and compatible seal
Primary_Materials: PCR-PP body/lid; minimal compatible seal and label
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Mass-neutral to ~10% lower possible only if components/design are simplified
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary B2B estimate
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: PCR-PP €1.80–3.20/kg planning estimate
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Oils/fragrance and product stability still need testing; mono-material claim depends on actual seal, label, adhesive and decoration.
Required_Catalogue_Data: PCR % proof, grade, odour/colour, jar-lid exact pairing, seal BOM and full-pack DfR assessment.
Important_Notes: PCR doesn't by itself prove lower lifecycle impact.

Packaging_Configuration: 500 mL PCR-HDPE bottle + PP dispensing cap
Primary_Materials: PCR-HDPE body; PP cap; label
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Near neutral to +15% body mass depending on PCR grade
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary B2B estimate
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: PCR-HDPE €1.80–3.20/kg planning estimate
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Surfactants, perfume/solvents, pH and seal require filled-pack compatibility testing; PCR grade needs variability control.
Required_Catalogue_Data: PCR % certificate, grade, cap seal, label, filled-pack stress/leak and material compatibility data.
Important_Notes: Manual hand dishwash only.

Packaging_Configuration: 500 mL PE-rich refill pouch
Primary_Materials: PE flexible film, optional barrier and fitment
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Estimated 50–75% lower mass per refill vs rigid bottle
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary custom pouch price band
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: PE film resin €1.43–1.63/kg base proxy
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Surfactant, fragrance and solvent content affects film/seal compatibility. A multilayer pack may not follow mono-PE recycling route.
Required_Catalogue_Data: Layer stack, fitment, barrier, seal tests, full-fill compatibility and target-market recycling information.
Important_Notes: Compare per equivalent volume/use.

Packaging_Configuration: Concentrated refill sachet for dilution in retained bottle
Primary_Materials: Paper/film barrier sachet or compatible dry/concentrate format; reused bottle
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Potentially >85% lower refill-pack mass if sachet is ~2–5 g; excludes amortized bottle
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Sachet-only budgetary estimate; concentrate manufacture excluded
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: Paper stock €1.20–1.80/kg is stock proxy; barrier film/conversion is extra
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Not a drop-in liquid. Reconstitution affects concentration, cleaning, preservation, water quality, user dosing and stability.
Required_Catalogue_Data: Dilution ratio, product performance, pack moisture barrier, seal, instruction clarity, microbiological/stability and compatibility tests.
Important_Notes: Only compare with a conventional pack on equivalent cleaning function.

Packaging_Configuration: 750 mL PCR-HDPE bottle + compatible trigger
Primary_Materials: PCR-HDPE bottle; compatible trigger (all-plastic or mixed; exact BOM required); label
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Near neutral to ~10% heavier possible; depends on PCR bottle/trigger
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary estimate; chemical-resistant trigger and PCR grades affect price
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: PCR-HDPE €1.80–3.20/kg estimate; PP resin is raw material proxy
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Same cleaner compatibility risk remains. Trigger internals (spring, gasket, dip tube, nozzle) often govern suitability for acids, alkalis, solvents or oxidizers.
Required_Catalogue_Data: PCR % evidence, trigger full BOM, chemical-resistance matrix, pH/solvent/oxidizer concentrations, spray-cycle and leak tests.
Important_Notes: All-plastic external appearance does not confirm every wetted part is plastic.

Packaging_Configuration: 500 mL PE-rich refill pouch
Primary_Materials: PE film with stated barrier and compatible PE/PP fitment
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Lower empty-pack mass than a new 750 mL trigger pack; volumes and format differ
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary custom pouch band; chemical-specific quote needed
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: PE film resin €1.43–1.63/kg base proxy
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: Strong acid/alkali, alcohol, solvent, essential oil and oxidizer may challenge laminate/fitment; test actual formula.
Required_Catalogue_Data: Layer BOM and mass, barrier, fitment, seal, leak/drop, chemistry data and country DfR evidence.
Important_Notes: Does not include the retained trigger bottle needed to use the refill.

Packaging_Configuration: Concentrate tablet/sachet for reused trigger bottle
Primary_Materials: Small paper/film barrier sachet or tablet wrap; consumer reuses trigger bottle
Mass_Change_vs_Baseline: Potentially >90% lower refill-pack mass than a new trigger pack, excluding bottle amortization
Cost_Basis_and_Confidence: Budgetary sachet-only estimate; tablet/formulation costs excluded
Material_Price_Hint_EUR_per_kg: Paper stock €1.20–1.80/kg; barrier/conversion costs extra
Compatibility_and_Performance_Flags: New product system. Validate dissolution, pH, efficacy, surface compatibility, preservative strategy, user dose and moisture stability.
Required_Catalogue_Data: Concentrate chemistry, dose/reconstitution, instruction testing, barrier/seal, spray pattern, stability, surface efficacy and required regulatory review.
Important_Notes: Only ordinary non-disinfectant cleaner in this template; antimicrobial claims may trigger separate rules.
